snippet.title: Cybernetic Strategy Trailer | A New Sci-Fi Auto Battler!
snippet.description:
Cybernetic Strategy is a flamboyant sci-fi auto-battler with an emphasis on being easier to play, powerful unit fantasies, and social competition!

Wishlist Cybernetic Strategy on Steam HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5226810/Cybernetic_Strategy/

Create a team of super cool robots as you battle it out in this sci-fi dominion! The game aims to be easier to play and more social than your traditional auto battler!

Cybernetic Strategy is currently in development! 

Join the Community Discord!: https://discord.gg/WaRTVZ6vY

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cyberneticstrategy/

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cybernetic.strate?_r=1&_t=ZS-99z6eNtbNx7

Music Credit: Fuzzeke

#CyberneticStrategy #AutoBattler #indiegame #teamfighttactics
